CustomObject.description: Announces that a credit bureau (CRI) record was accessed. Publish Behavior is Publish Immediately, not Publish After Commit: the event leaves the publishing transaction the moment it is published, so the subscriber writes the Credit_Check_Log__c audit row in its own transaction and the audit survives a rollback of the pull that caused it. After-commit would die with that rollback, which would defeat the purpose.
CustomObject.label: Credit Check Logged
